THE UPRISING Digital Streaming Release Date Revealed

When To Stream18 hours ago18 hours ago02 mins
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 0:57
Instaread

According to our sources, Focus Features is expected to release their action drama THE UPRISING on VOD and digital platforms later this month, arriving on September 29th, 2026. The film launched in US theaters on September 11th, 2026.

Please note: Focus Features has neither announced nor confirmed the release date. As always, release dates are subject to change.

Advertisement

The Uprising is written, produced and directed by Paul Greengrass, and stars Andrew Garfield, Jamie Bell, Stephen Dillane, Tom Hollander, Cosmo Jarvis, Thomasin McKenzie, Jonny Lee Miller, Woody Norman and Katherine Waterston.

Andrew Garfield stars as the leader of a ferocious rebellion against the tyranny of King Richard II. Set against the true events of the Uprising that helped inspire the legend of Robin Hood, he forms an army of the people to face the King’s might in a fight for justice.

We’ve added the release date to our Streaming Calendar. Check out the film’s official US trailer below.
